description:
DuckDB + TPC-DS loading fails after TPC-DS datagen was changed to remove trailing
delimiters from generated .dat files. The pipe-delimited loader in
DuckDBNativeHandler.load_table() unconditionally appends a _trailing_delimiter_
dummy column and uses SELECT * EXCLUDE (_trailing_delimiter_), which causes a
Binder Error when the file has no trailing delimiter.

Observed in a 72-run DuckDB version matrix (1.0.0-1.5.0rc1) across tpch/tpcds/
clickbench/ssb - TPC-H succeeds but TPC-DS consistently fails with:
  - "Binder Error: Column '_trailing_delimiter_' in EXCLUDE list not found in FROM clause"
  - "Data validation failed - benchmark execution halted"
  - "Empty tables detected: ..."

Additionally, `benchbox run` exits with code 0 even when the benchmark status is
FAILED, masking failures in automation pipelines. No result JSON is written for
failed runs.

Utility functions `has_trailing_delimiter()` and `get_column_names_with_trailing()`
already exist in benchbox/utils/file_format.py but are not used by the loader.

anti_patterns.dont: check trailing delimiter on every shard
anti_patterns.instead: sample the first shard only and assume consistency within a table
anti_patterns.why: has_trailing_delimiter() opens and reads the file, and TPC-DS has hundreds of shards

anti_patterns.instead: keep it as a safety net
anti_patterns.why: some older TPC-DS data files may have inconsistent trailing delimiters across shards
Click manages exit codes via ctx.exit()
